lines.text: The proposal seeks administrative sanction for works costing above Rs.1.00 crore.
In File USD01-WRKS0/18/2023-WORKS, Note #4, on 04-08-2023, the matter was seen and recorded.
In File USD01-WRKS0/52/2024-WORKS, Note #4, on 21-10-2024, the proposal was approved and G.O. was issued.
AP-USD01-GOMS-27-2024, dated 06-08-2024, issued orders revising the delegation of powers for according administrative sanction to works, including emergency works.
Under AP-USD01-GOMS-27-2024#para-2.vi, the Government is the competent authority for works, including emergency works, costing above Rs.1.00 crore.
The proposal seeks approval by the Commissioner, who is not the competent authority for works costing above Rs.1.00 crore.
Review recommended: verify the authority as the proposal relies on AP-USD01-CIRMEMO-USD01WRKS0-9-2023-D20230711, which was not found among the indexed records.
Review recommended: submit the proposal to the Government, as the Commissioner is not the competent authority.
It is submitted that submitting the proposal to the Government for administrative sanction of works costing above Rs.1.00 crore may kindly be considered.
